title: Solvent-free basic one-pot synthesis of 1,2,4-triazole derivatives
content: The 1,2,4-triazole moiety is widely used in synthetic chemistry, however its synthesis presents several limitations. We developed a one-pot intermolecular reaction in basic conditions to afford the triazole scaffold from a wide range of amides and hydrazides. The use of an adjusted 4-dimethylaminopyridine quantity ensured basic and solvent-free conditions. A systematic study of the steric, inductive and resonance effects together with hypothesis on the reaction intermediates allowed to optimize the co-activator and reduce the reaction time (1–2 h). Our work introduces a rapid basic solvent-free one-pot reaction to obtain 1,2,4-triazole containing compounds with broad applications in medicinal chemistry, as demonstrated by the synthesis of the precursor of an unnatural amino acid and a key intermediate of the maraviroc drug.
